note: LoanOriginator status vocabulary. LoanOriginatorStatus is a STRING enum — it has no ordinal: the value the oracle stores/returns is the enum name string itself (ACTIVE/PENDING/INACTIVE), observed from GET /loan-originators/template statusOptions. A wrong mapping (e.g. PENDING stored as ACTIVE) silently corrupts every originator written.

roundingSurface.seam: none — this context carries no money
roundingSurface.note: No minor-unit, rounding or currency surface exists. There is no ordinal to pin; each vector pins enum NAME <-> STORED STRING.

objects.outOfScope: originatorTypeOptions and channelTypeOptions are code-value driven (m_code_value), not this enum vocabulary; they are captured for the record only.
